issue_request: FHIR-3611 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 correction for the Integrated Examples Additional research text, where an E. cloacae culture was described as sensitive to Salbutamol even though salbutamol is not an antibiotic. The work group agreed to correct the text to an actual antibiotic.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git commit 18441587ba4a6c0e507149b2af2215aa6616888b (#3611 - fix language), which changed source/integrated-examples.html from Salbutamol to vancomycin in the culture sensitivity and policy sentences. The Jira comment records the application as svn revision 9182.
additional_context: The current page remains in build scope through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related final issue or community record that changes the original correction.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because source/integrated-examples.html already says E. cloacae is sensitive to vancomycin rather than salbutamol.
